name: UnexpectedMedical

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Family members helping each other navigate an unexpected bill
setting.background: An unplanned expense disrupts an otherwise stable monthly budget

scenario_template.note: They discuss the amount and when payment is needed

scenario_template.topic: Figuring out how to cover the bill without missing other obligations
scenario_template.note: The expense competes with rent, food, and existing savings goals
They ask what expenses might reasonably be postponed

scenario_template.topic: Prioritizing essential bills and temporarily reducing flexible spending
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them distinguish urgent obligations from optional spending

scenario_template.topic: Deciding whether to use existing savings
scenario_template.note: They weigh preserving savings against avoiding financial strain
Assistant helps them create a recovery plan

scenario_template.topic: Settling on a revised short-term budget
scenario_template.note: They accept that the month will look different but manageable

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
